\[
\mathcal{D}(B)
\approx
C\,2^{-2B/k_{\mathrm{eff}}},

where \(B\) is the coordinate bit budget and \(k_{\mathrm{eff}}\) is the number of directions that materially contribute in the tested regime. Equivalently,

B_{\min}(\epsilon)
\approx
\frac{k_{\mathrm{eff}}}{2}

It yields several testable predictions:
